name: moving-with-children
description:
Produces child-specific task layers for household moves including
age-appropriate conversation guides, school transition checklists,
emotional preparation strategies, and child-focused moving day plans.
Supplements the general moving-checklist with tasks specific to
relocating with children of different developmental stages.
Use when the user asks about moving with kids, helping children
adjust to a move, or child-specific moving logistics.
Do NOT use for general moving logistics without children
(use moving-checklist), international relocation, or child custody
and relocation legal issues (consult an attorney).
